title: Hermes SMS Opt-In and Consent
text:
Service identity

spaceynyc Hermes SMS is a private, single-user personal-automation service operated by Steven Richardson. It allows the sole account owner to send questions and commands to a personal Hermes agent and receive automated replies, reminders, and home-status or account notifications.

SMS OPT-IN

Join spaceynyc Hermes SMS

Text START to +1 888-527-6495 to receive automated personal-assistant replies, reminders, and home-status or account notifications from spaceynyc Hermes SMS.

Message frequency varies, generally fewer than 100 messages per month. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for assistance.

By texting START, you consent to receive these automated SMS messages at the number used to send the keyword. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Review the Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions.

How to opt in

The sole account owner opts in by texting START to +1 888-527-6495.

By texting START, the account owner expressly consents to receive automated SMS replies, reminders, and home-status or account notifications from spaceynyc Hermes SMS at the mobile number used to send the keyword.

Consent is not a condition of purchasing goods or services. This program sends no marketing or promotional messages and is not offered to third-party users.

Messaging disclosures
Message frequency varies, generally fewer than 100 messages per month.
Message and data rates may apply.
Reply STOP at any time to opt out.
Reply HELP for assistance or email srich7x@gmail.com.
After an opt-out request, no further messages will be sent unless the account owner opts in again.
The service is intended only for the authorized account owner.
Sample messages
spaceynyc Hermes: Reminder set for 3:00 PM. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for assistance. Msg & data rates may apply.
spaceynyc Hermes: Attic AC is on; target temperature is 74°F. Reply STOP to opt out.
spaceynyc Hermes: Today’s weather in Kings Park is 78°F with a chance of rain. Reply STOP to opt out.
Policies

Review the Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions.

title: Privacy Policy
text:
SMS and mobile information

Mobile information, phone numbers, SMS opt-in data, and consent records will not be sold, rented, or shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.

Information may be used only as necessary to operate, secure, and support the requested spaceynyc Hermes SMS service, or when disclosure is required by law. SMS opt-in data and consent are not shared with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

Information used by the service

The service may process the account owner’s phone number, message content, commands, reminders, and delivery or consent records to provide requested automated replies and notifications.

Choices and contact

Reply STOP to opt out of SMS messages. Reply HELP for assistance or email srich7x@gmail.com.

title: Terms and Conditions
text:
Program description

spaceynyc Hermes SMS is operated by Steven Richardson as a private, single-user personal-automation service. It sends automated replies, reminders, and home-status or account notifications to its authorized account owner.

Enrollment and messaging

After reviewing the consent information at spaceynyc.dev/hermes-sms, the sole account owner may enroll by texting START to +1 888-527-6495.

Message frequency varies and is generally fewer than 100 messages per month. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP at any time to cancel. Reply HELP for assistance or contact srich7x@gmail.com. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

The program does not send marketing messages and is not available for enrollment by third-party users.

Privacy

Use of the SMS service is also governed by the Privacy Policy.
